d: Short, layered lavender-purple hair with blunt bangs frames a youthful face with wide, golden-yellow eyes. A slender build is dressed in a red and white outfit featuring a gold-trimmed bodice, a short white underskirt, and a red open-front overcoat with gold accents, paired with dark purple thigh-high stockings and gold pointed footwear. The ensemble is accessorized with a floating red book featuring a single eye on the cover, a long white parchment scroll with black inscriptions, and a large golden calligraphy brush.
